name: Hyatt Regency Dehradun
line: Heat That Holds Against The Wind
lede: In the foothills of the Himalayas, a new luxury hotel wanted its terraces and rooftop bar warm despite strong winds. Bromic’s heat plan put Tungsten Electric where the wind blows hardest and freestanding Eclipse heaters where there is nothing to mount to.
data: Five-star hotel – rooftop bar, restaurants, lounges
Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric · Eclipse Smart-Heat® Freestanding
Eclipse Dimmer Controller; Tungsten to confirm

Eclipse Freestanding over a rooftop lounge at night. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: Opened in March 2022 on 4.25 acres, the hotel has more than 250 rooms over seven floors, with restaurants, lounges and Beyul, a rooftop bar, all designed around the view.
Strong winds were common at the rooftop bar and the all-day dining restaurant. The heaters had to hold up to them and blend into each space without changing its look.

Working with architect Love Chaudhary of AND Studio through Bromic’s complimentary design service, the team chose Tungsten Electric for precise directional heat in the restaurants and on the rooftop, and Eclipse Freestanding for heat and light in lounges with no ceiling or wall to mount to.
